selection_rule: Preserve every seed and every method. Select representative BC and BC+PPO by highest stable success on 7000-7099, then lowest final distance, then lowest training seed. Freeze config and all hashes before one final 8000-8099 evaluation of all declared methods. DAgger trigger uses 6000-6099 closed-loop validation, training data only 5000-5099; never use selection or final data for labels.
